The difference between the Net Booking Value and the Net Rate shall belong to the Franchisor as its reseller margin

The Franchisee understands this Clause restricts its ability to contract with third parties for providing accommodation in its Hotel during the Period of Exclusivity and further agrees that it has been compensated with fair and adequate compensation in consideration for this restriction and understands this clause shall not be considered as a restraint of trade. The Franchisee agrees and acknowledges that the Franchisor has made a substantial investment in the Platform and the System being made available to the Franchisee hereunder and any restrictions during the Period of Exclusivity are fair and reasonable restrictions necessary to protect the Franchisor’s interest and investment.

prior written approval of the Franchisor, which approval may be withheld, delayed or denied in the Franchisor’s sole discretion.
Any assignment or purported assignment of this Agreement by the Franchisee without such prior written consent is a material breach of this Agreement.

Any of the shareholders of the Franchisor may transfer their ownership rights in the Franchisor or any of its Affiliates, by operation of law or otherwise, including by public offering, to any person or legal entity without the Franchisee’s consent.
If the Franchisor transfers this Agreement

For the purposes of this Clause, the Parties agree that the term "gross negligence" means intentional conduct of an unreasonable character performed in conscious disregard of a risk either actually known to the Franchisor or a risk which is so evident it would be obvious to anyone, and where such risk is so great as to make it highly probable that foreseeable grave harm or loss will follow (and has done so) as a direct result of such conduct, but such conduct is carried on in conscious indifference to the outcome.

Notwithstanding anything contained in this Agreement, neither Party shall be liable to the other Party, for any failure to perform nor any delay in the performance of any of its obligations herein, where such failure or delay is caused by any Force Majeure event. Provided however that the Party who is unable to, or is delayed in, performing any of its obligations due to any Force Majeure event, shall give prompt notice of the same to the other Party, and such Party shall take all necessary steps to mitigate the effects of the Force Majeure event in the operation of the Hotel.

On the pendency of a Force Majeure for a period of 6 (six) consecutive months, the Party, unaffected by such Force Majeure event, shall have the right (but not the obligation) to terminate this Agreement by giving 30 (thirty) days’ prior written notice to the Party who is unable to comply with the terms of this Agreement due to continuance of an event of Force Majeure.

The Franchisor may terminate this Agreement by giving a written notice to the Franchisee at any time before it expires if the Franchisee fails to cure any of the following defaults within a period of 30 (thirty) days:
the Franchisee fails to pay any sums due and owing to the Franchisor or any of the Affiliates under this Agreement; or
the Franchisee fails to comply with any provisions of this Agreement, or the Brand Standards.

the Franchisee receives 3 (three) or more notices of default in any 12 (twelve) month period, even if cured;

Franchisee’s Obligations upon Termination or Expiry
Upon termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Franchisee will:

immediately pay all sums due and owing to the Franchisor and any of the Entities, including all costs and expenses incurred by the Franchisor and/or any of the Entities in obtaining injunctive relief in connection with the enforcement of this Agreement;
immediately cease operating the Hotel as a Brand Hotel and cease using the System;

immediately cease using the Trademarks including the domain name, the IP, and any confusingly similar names, marks, trade dress systems, insignia, symbols, or other rights, procedures, and methods. The Franchisee will deliver all goods and materials containing the Trademarks to the Franchisor and the Franchisor will have the sole and exclusive use of any items containing the Trademarks or, if the Franchisor shall require, the Franchisee shall have such of the goods and materials containing the Marks (as the Franchisor directs) destroyed and the Franchisee shall certify in writing to such destruction to the Franchisor. The Franchisee will immediately make any specified changes to the Hotel Site as the Franchisor may reasonably require for this purpose, which will include removal of the signs, custom decorations, and promotional materials;

a Brand Hotel and/or formerly a Brand Hotel;

Parties shall initially attempt to resolve all disputes pertaining to this Agreement by negotiation between senior business representatives who are at a higher level of management than the persons with direct responsibility for administration of this Agreement and who have authority to settle the dispute, and (if they so desire) counsel. If within a period of 30 (thirty) days of the dispute arising, Parties are unable to resolve the same, the dispute shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with Clause 15.2 for settlement.

Arbitration shall be conducted under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 as amended from time to time. The arbitral tribunal shall consist of 3 (three) arbitrators, out of which, each Party shall have the right to appoint 1 (one) arbitrator each and the arbitrators so appointed by each Party, shall jointly appoint the third arbitrator. The venue of arbitration shall be New Delhi and the language used in the arbitral proceedings shall be English.

In the event that a dispute is pending, including where it has been referred to arbitration, the Parties shall continue to perform their respective obligations under the Agreement to the extent unrelated to the subject-matter of the dispute unless the entire Agreement has been terminated. Such performance shall however be without prejudice to the outcome of the resolution of the Dispute under this Clause 15. expressly stated in this Agreement, be paid by the Party that is allegedly liable to pay the same.
